raw.query: SELECT family,predictor,resolution,signal,horizon_h,metric,context_window,n_origins_available,n_origins_used,wape,n_fail,n_nonfinite,is_best_fm,is_valid,source_path FROM provenance.forecast_eval WHERE signal ILIKE '%image%' OR signal ILIKE '%vision%' ORDER BY resolution,horizon_h,predictor LIMIT 1000
raw.observed: At 15s, foundation model toto/cov WAPE=0.6374, below ARIMA=0.6675, Prophet=0.7328, constant=0.7638, and Kalman=0.8111; all rows are is_valid=true with n_fail=0 and n_nonfinite=0.
